mapper.sql: act14_link_id AS link_id , act14_company_id AS company_id , act14_account_cd AS account_code , act14_provide_content_cd AS provide_content_code , act14_seq AS seq , f_cdnm('ProvidePurCode' , SUBSTR(act14_provide_content_cd,1,2), act14_company_id, f_today()) || '-' || f_cdnm('ProvideContentCode', act14_provide_content_cd , act14_company_id, f_today()) AS provide_name
mapper.select: SELECT sys09_code.sys09_code AS code , sys09_code.sys09_name AS name FROM sys09_code , sys08_code_kind WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'ProvideContentCode' AND sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_code LIKE #{code} AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn, 'false') = 'false' ORDER BY sys09_seq
